# Claude Shannon — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Claude Shannon work in?", "information theory"),
    ("What is Claude Shannon known for?", "mathematical theory of communication"),
    ("What is lived?", "1916-2001"),
    ("What is field?", "information theory"),
    ("What is known for?", "mathematical theory of communication"),
    ("What is note?", "The bit; father of the information age"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
